Binding capacity limit is the ID-based Rial deposit cap: 25,000,000 IRT per 24h per payer Sheba/ID = ~97.3 USDT at 257,000 IRT/USDT. Crediting 100 USDT at a provider costs ~26.05M IRT (>1 allowance-day); one allowance sustains ~1 x $100 order/day; the first-pass 30 orders/day target needs ~31 allowances and a 15,000 USDT float (3.86B IRT). 72h post-deposit crypto-withdrawal lock (per-deposit rolling assumed): float = D x (3+2 days); seeding 5,000 USDT from Rial alone = 52 allowance-days, so seed float must come from USDT/OTC/own holdings, not the ID rail.

All-in conversion premium over mid (taker 0.25%, ASSUMED spread 0.10%, 1 USDT TRC20 withdrawal): 4.36% @$25, 1.35% @$100, 0.55% @$500, 0.40% @$2000. Reported TRC20 withdrawal fees range 1.0 (Nobitex, secondary) to 3.5 USDT (Ramzinex) -> 14.4% @$25; batching withdrawals (>= w/0.005 USDT per sweep) and choosing TON/BEP20 (~0.8) are the main cost levers. Spreads/depth were unobtainable (assumptions, flagged).

Sanctions changed the venue map: Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin, Ramzinex (OFAC SDN 2026-06-02) and Aban Tether (2026-08-07, imported from sanctions specialist's file 05 because my searches missed it); file 05 counts 7 designated domestic-market exchanges (also Shelbit, BitBank 2026-09-17) and advises not using them as USDT sources. Non-designated venues (Tabdeal, Bit24, Exir, OMPFinex, Tetherland, NovinTether...) have very thin data. Tether froze ~USD 550M Iran-linked USDT in 2026.

Nobitex API (official docs read directly): GET https://apiv2.nobitex.ir/v3/orderbook/USDTIRT 300 req/min; stats 20/min; trades 60/min; WS wss://ws.nobitex.ir/connection/websocket (Centrifugo); IRT-market prices are in RIAL (divide by 10); min order 3,000,000 Rial / 11 USDT; max 10 crypto + 3 Rial withdrawals per 24h; per-Sheba Rial cap 200M IRT; whitelist 'safe withdrawal' (disable -> 24h block; new device -> 1h; emergency cancel -> 72h); GET /v2/options gives live fees/limits. Bitpin/Wallex quote Toman; Tabdeal/Exir/Bit24/AbanTether endpoints from SDK source (medium/low).

Policy timeline 2022-2026 delivered (17 rules + 8 events in data/regulatory_limits.json; 19 rows in doc): FATA 72h lock existed by 2023-09-12; ID cap cut dated 2024-09-07 (conflicts with a 2022-12 summary); gateways blocked 2024-12-26 (Dey 1403; a Dey-1404 closure is NOT evidenced); hack 2025-06-18 (~USD 90M burned); designations 2026-06-02/08-07/09-17; current-state matrix and last-90-days list included.
